CBTS is seeking a Platform Engineer I to support foreign exchange (FX) technology initiatives. The role involves applying software engineering and database concepts while learning and adapting to new technologies in an onsite Cincinnati environment.
Entry-level platform engineer supporting foreign exchange technology and relational database systems

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in:
• Computer Science
• Information Systems
• Software Engineering
• Computer Engineering
• Data Analytics
• Or related technical discipline
• 0-3 years of technology experience
• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
• Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
